quarterly_data.quarter: Celestica press release: Celestica Introduces the DS6005 Data Center Switch with (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Celestica introduced the DS6005, a co-packaged optics (CPO) data center switching system for AI scale-up and scale-out networking: up to 102.4Tbps of switching capacity (64 x 1.6TbE ports) in a fully liquid-cooled 1.5OU form factor for OCP ORv3 racks, with optical engines integrated on the switch ASIC (no front-panel pluggable optics), field-replaceable external laser modules and SONiC support. Gavin Cato (SVP & GM Portfolio Solutions & AI Platform Engineering): the DS6005 brings co-packaged optics, liquid cooling, field-replaceable external laser modules and CPO-aware software management together to help customers build scalable, power-efficient AI fabrics. Celestica showcases it at the OCP Global Summit 2026; no availability date is given.
quarterly_data.figure: DS6005: 102.4Tbps, 64 x 1.6TbE ports, 1.5OU liquid-cooled CPO switch

contracts.source: Celestica press release: Celestica Introduces the DS6005 Data Center Switch with (10-12-2026)
contracts.signal: Celestica's DS6005 CPO switch is built on the Broadcom Tomahawk 6 - Davisson switch chip. Manish Mehta (VP Marketing and Operations, Optical Systems Division, Broadcom): combining Broadcom's Tomahawk 6 - Davisson platform and optical expertise with Celestica's system engineering and platform execution, the DS6005 demonstrates how the partnership is helping bring CPO to market for AI networking.
